en: Black‑and‑white postcard showing a triptych painting mounted on an ornate interior wall. The central panel depicts the Lamentation over the dead Christ, surrounded by Mary and other figures; numerous small angels appear above. Flanking side panels show donor figures and other religious personages. Decorative inscriptions in Latin or German appear in the upper parts of the side panels. Beneath the image, in cursive German script, is a caption identifying the location and artist.
